name: Video Thumbnail Decode Failure Suppression
changes: Preserves browser-side Video thumbnail error codes through the UI failure path so browser-decode-failed and ffmpeg-required are no longer downgraded to generic retryable preview_failed errors.

Treats confirmed browser codec/decoder limitations as non-retryable for the current runtime, retains them across group refreshes, excludes them from Related Media representative selection, and blocks stale thumbnail queue paths from re-requesting them.
Keeps transient browser frame timeout, frame capture, thumbnail-store, and other unknown failures retryable; cached non-retryable failures no longer render a Retry button.
Browsing-performance schema 9 adds passive video_thumbnail_policy reason telemetry so the decode-suppression policy can be accepted without recording media contents.

Preserves the accepted six-slot Video ceiling, five-request Image HTTP gate, 24 MB/12-segment Video sample bounds, 800/800/1000 headers, All Posts accumulator, settings-save retry behavior, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, Discover, Smart Import, and Automation behavior.
regression_guards: No FFmpeg or other decoder is bundled; this release changes retry/suppression semantics only for already-confirmed browser decode limitations.
browser-decode-failed and ffmpeg-required are definitive non-retryable client Video outcomes, while timeout/capture/store failures remain retryable.
Known unsupported media are not requeued through stale main-gallery or Related Media cover paths during the same runtime.

Image admission stays 5, high-connection Video ceiling stays 6, Video sample bounds stay 24 MB/12 segments, browsing headers stay 800/800/1000, and All Posts render accumulator constants remain unchanged.
Settings save retry remains limited to WinError 5/32/33 for 3 seconds; SABnzbd remains 5.1.2 and terminal-history schema remains 3.
